description: Limit how often one person sees an ad squad's ads: at most `count` impressions per `every` HOURS or DAYS (up to 30 days), or clear the cap. A cap lowers repetition (and so frequency), and may lower delivery. Undo works when a cap existed before. Previews unless confirm=true. Two steps: confirm=false returns a preview and an approval_token; to apply, repeat the same arguments with confirm=true and that approval_token.

approval_token.description: The approval_token returned by the preview of this exact request. Required with confirm=true.

confirm.description: false = preview only (nothing sent). true = apply; needs approval_token from the preview.

name: snap_set_frequency_cap
